_note: Knowledge graph spec for the VLS demo. Nodes come from rows, column values, and entities extracted from unstructured documents; edges connect them. Companion narrative: Knowledge_Graph_Overview.docx. Numbers cite 04_structured_data / the entity roster.

node_types.description: A physical EPA-regulated site: the receiving TSDF, inbound generators, transporters, and comparator TSDFs. One node per resolved EPA handler ID.
A public enforcement document (consent decree, CAFO, complaint, settlement). Entities extracted from the text resolve onto Facility nodes.
One cradle-to-grave hazardous-waste shipment. Sample instances included for the trace path; the full set is 1,200 rows.
An EPA hazardous-waste code (D/F/U/P series) carried on manifests. Dimension node derived from column values.
A class of RCRA enforcement action. Dimension node derived from column values.
A class of RCRA violation. Dimension node derived from column values.
